item_short_desc: Rothco's Two-Tone Duck Style Rain Boots are 6" waterproof boots for combating the rain and snow.
description: Rothco's Two-Tone Duck Style Rain Boots are 6" waterproof boots for combating the rain and snow. The boots have a brown leather material with a matte finish and rubber outsoles for maximum waterproof protection. Features include a gusseted tongue, steel shank, and a 4mm sponge lining for added comfort. Durable and waterproof, Rothco's Duck Boots are the ultimate rain boots.
